exposure: Irregularity and width of uterine-bladder interface
irregularity and width of uterine-bladder interface
cohort: Pregnant women with ≥1 prior cesarean delivery who received an ultrasound diagnosis of placenta previa or low-lying placenta in the third trimester (n=184)
finding: A combination of smallest sagittal myometrial thickness, lacunae, and bridging vessels, in addition to number of cesarean deliveries and placental location, yielded an area under the curve of 0.87 (95% confidence interval, 0.80-0.95) for predicting placental invasion.
